page_title: NAN 1-1 LOR | Nantes v Lorient 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle. Johann Lepenant (Nantes) commits a foul after dangerous play. Free kick. Lorient will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+4' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Bamo Meite goes off and Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) comes on.
90+1' 1 - 1 Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) is first to latch onto the rebound near the penalty spot, and he produces a fantastic header which goes low inside the left post.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
84' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
82' Shots on target – 1:1.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amady Camara (Nantes) will replace Dehmaine Tabibou.
76' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
75' Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul after Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Nantes earn a free kick.

72' Matthis Abline (Nantes) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the crossbar and wastes a promising chance. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
71' Substitution. Sambou Soumano will be replaced by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
69' Nantes will take a corner kick.
68' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Nantes are awarded the free kick.
65' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lorient.
62' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Mayckel Lahdo and he is replaced by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
59' Here's the change. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon leaves the pitch and Johann Lepenant (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Youssef El Arabi as he is replaced by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).
59' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to make a change. Pablo Pagis (Lorient) replaces Dermane Karim.
59' Substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Aiyegun Tosin walks off.
54' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
53' Neat passing move from Nantes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
51' A pass from Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) is intercepted by Yvon Mvogo and the move breaks down.
48' Arthur Avom (Lorient) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' The referee shows the yellow card to Anthony Lopes (Nantes).
45+6' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Lorient players have a reason to celebrate!
45+4' Lorient score a goal, but referee Ruddy Buquet has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) sent the ball towards his own goal in an attempt to intercept a pass.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Bamo Meite (Lorient) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ruddy Buquet has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Nantes.
44' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
41' Hyeok-Kyu Kwon (Nantes) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
39' Arthur Avom (Lorient) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Ruddy Buquet has a clear sight and sees a foul from Youssef El Arabi (Nantes). Lorient are awarded a free kick.

37' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a throw-in.
36' Mayckel Lahdo (Nantes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Wonderful movement by Nantes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Mayckel Lahdo (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Noah Cadiou (Lorient) commits a rough challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Nantes.
32' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Nantes.
31' 0:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
28' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lorient.

27' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle as Sambou Soumano (Lorient) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Nantes, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
25' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
24' Mayckel Lahdo (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) makes a rough challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul. Lorient get a free kick.
23' Great teamplay by Lorient as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

18' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lorient are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
17' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Lorient will take a free kick near the side line.
13' The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
8' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
6' The Lorient players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lorient will take the kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
